item.title: bussilab.cron v0.0.42
item.description: • Use integer event/period division when evaluating skip/delay schedules.
item.content:encoded: • Use integer event/period division when evaluating skip/delay schedules.

item.title: bussilab.cron v0.0.41
item.description: • Read the period from configuration when not explicitly overridden, and reload it during operation. Support a mapping with period and steps alongside the original list form; rename jobs to steps. • Resume at the next step after reboot/self-update, preserving the scheduled event and remaining iteration count. Add quick-start resume options. • Account for fractional seconds when waiting for scheduled events; improve event/step logging and continue after unsupported Screen reboot requests. • Shorten long Screen socket names with a hash suffix.
item.content:encoded:
• Read the period from configuration when not explicitly overridden, and reload it during operation. Support a mapping with period and steps alongside the original list form; rename jobs to steps.
  • Resume at the next step after reboot/self-update, preserving the scheduled event and remaining iteration count. Add quick-start resume options.
  • Account for fractional seconds when waiting for scheduled events; improve event/step logging and continue after unsupported Screen reboot requests.
  • Shorten long Screen socket names with a hash suffix.

item.title: bussilab.cron v0.0.35
item.description: • Add self-update and reboot steps using replacement Screen windows, preserving detached mode and checking for Screen 4.1 or newer. • Align scheduling to the local week and allow expressions in skip/delay. • Parse Screen/Python command strings with shlex.split() and respect iteration limits before waiting for another event.
item.content:encoded:
• Add self-update and reboot steps using replacement Screen windows, preserving detached mode and checking for Screen 4.1 or newer.
  • Align scheduling to the local week and allow expressions in skip/delay.
  • Parse Screen/Python command strings with shlex.split() and respect iteration limits before waiting for another event.

item.title: bussilab.cron v0.0.34
item.description: • Add Bash steps, skip/delay scheduling and unique Screen session checks. • Derive default socket names from configuration paths and preserve LD_LIBRARY_PATH by default when launching through Screen.
item.content:encoded:
• Add Bash steps, skip/delay scheduling and unique Screen session checks.
  • Derive default socket names from configuration paths and preserve LD_LIBRARY_PATH by default when launching through Screen.

item.title: bussilab.cron v0.0.33
item.description: • Add optional LD_LIBRARY_PATH forwarding to Screen sessions.

item.title: bussilab.cron v0.0.11

item.title: bussilab.cron v0.0.2
item.description: • Introduce periodic Python scripts from YAML configuration, optional Screen sessions, quick start, subprocess timeouts and configuration reloads.
